entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane once split into five shards that are now merging in the Conflux.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of Alara, home to gargantuan creatures such as the Cliffrunner Behemoth.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A volcanic shard of Alara, dragon-infested and home to goblins and huge beasts.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara with structured shores, at war with Bant and Grixis.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara with towers and knights, overlapped by Esper.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara, a horrid Dregscape that has crushed together with Esper.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A planeswalker and dragon who fled Dominaria and has built conflict between the shards.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: A colossal hydra-like being so vast it interferes with weather and blends into the Alaran landscape.

entities.name: Apocalypse Hydra
entities.description: A huge multi-headed hydra crushing Bant towers in Valeron.

entities.name: Cliffrunner Behemoth
entities.description: A massive rhino-like beast of Naya.

entities.name: Paleoloth
entities.description: A huge roaring beast of Naya, worshipped by people around it.

entities.name: Seekers of Carmot
entities.description: A group on Esper that seeks a red stone resembling the crystal of Jund.

entities.name: The Conflux
entities.description: The merging of Alara's five shards, creating incursion zones and a forming Maelstrom.

entities.name: The Maelstrom
entities.description: A spiraling valley forming at the union point of the five merged shards.

events.summary: The column explains that the Conflux has so far physically overlapped only adjacent shards, so Esper's main conflicts are with Bant and Grixis.
events.quote: the main conflicts for Esper have been with Bant and Grixis

events.summary: Esper and Grixis crush together at their frontiers, with thousands dying.
Nicol Bolas is said to have fled Dominaria and spent years building conflict between the shards.
events.quote: He's spent many years (since when he fled Dominaria at the end of the Future Sight novel)

relations.note: Their shards have crushed together in conflict.
Main conflicts for Esper are with Bant and Grixis.
relations.quote: the main conflicts for Esper have been with Bant and Grixis
